title: Zsh completion: escape colons in the value only when the item has help text; don't change _SOURCE_ZSH

note.title: Zsh completion: escape colons in the value only when the item has help text; don't change _SOURCE_ZSH
answers: zsh tab completion breaks for commands or choices containing a colon
why does click escape ':' in zsh completion output
can I change the zsh completion script in click shell_completion.py
zsh completion shows wrong item or splits description at colon
note.body:
Symptom: In zsh, a completion item with a colon in its name (e.g. a subcommand `c:d`) shows up truncated, or gets mixed into its description, when the item has help text (issue #2703).
Root cause: the installed zsh script (src/click/shell_completion.py:_SOURCE_ZSH) passes items that have help to `_describe`, which splits value from description at the first unescaped colon. Items whose help is the sentinel `_` go to `compadd`, which takes the value literally and has no colon escaping. ZshComplete.format_completion used to emit values without escaping them.
Fix pattern: in src/click/shell_completion.py:ZshComplete.format_completion, write `value.replace(':', r'\:')` only when help is not `_`. Values without help stay unescaped, because escaping them would corrupt the item. Colons in the help text are never escaped.
Constraints: treat _SOURCE_ZSH as frozen. Users already have it installed in their shells, so any change to the format has to happen on the Python side in format_completion. The output is `type\nvalue\nhelp` per item, and `_` is the 'no help' sentinel that the script checks for. Keep it.
